_comment: Campaign types. One is chosen per run - from the request when it names one, otherwise rotated against history so the feed keeps changing. {instrument}, {manufacturer}, {website} are filled in at render time. Add your own freely.

campaigns.label: Website / Self-Help
headlines: Your first stop when it stops
subheads: Troubleshooting guides, checklists and service requests at {website}
Common faults, causes and fixes - written by engineers
Diagnose it yourself, or raise a call in one click
voice: Instrument down? Before you call anyone, visit {website}. Vision Analytical's troubleshooting guides walk you through the common faults on {instrument}, step by step, and you can raise a service call from the same page.
Not sure what the error means? {website} has engineer-written checklists for {instrument}. Find the cause in minutes, and if you still need us, we are one click away.

campaigns.label: Instrument Sales
subheads: {instrument} supplied, installed and qualified by Vision Analytical
Delivered, installed and handed over running
Complete with installation, qualification and training
voice: Looking for {instrument}? Vision Analytical supplies, installs and qualifies it - and supports it long after the handover. Request a quotation at {website}.

campaigns.label: Refurbished / Recovery
subheads: Every module stripped, serviced and tested against original specification
Refurbished {manufacturer} systems with documented test results
Fully reconditioned and qualification-ready
voice: A refurbished {instrument} from Vision Analytical is not a gamble. Every module is stripped, serviced and tested against original specification, and you get the documented results with it. See what is available at {website}.

campaigns.label: Breakdown / Service
subheads: Engineer visits, spare parts and documented repairs
Diagnosis, repair and performance verification
Support for {manufacturer} systems across the country
voice: When {instrument} stops, your batch stops. Vision Analytical engineers diagnose, repair and verify performance - and document what was done. Raise a service call at {website}.

campaigns.label: AMC / CMC
headlines: Cover the instrument, protect the schedule
subheads: Planned visits, priority response and parts cover
Scheduled maintenance that keeps {instrument} qualified
Comprehensive or annual cover, your choice
voice: An AMC from Vision Analytical turns unplanned downtime into planned visits. Your {instrument} stays qualified, your parts are covered, and your response is priority. Ask for a quotation at {website}.

campaigns.label: IQ / OQ / PQ
subheads: Full qualification protocols and reports for {instrument}
Executed by engineers, documented for auditors
Installation, operational and performance qualification
voice: Qualification is only useful if it stands up to an audit. Vision Analytical executes IQ, OQ and PQ on {instrument} and hands you the documentation your auditor expects. Book it at {website}.

campaigns.label: Spare Parts & Consumables
headlines: The part you need, when you need it
Spares that keep the run going
subheads: Genuine and compatible parts for {manufacturer} systems
Columns, lamps, seals, filters and fittings
Send us the part number - we will confirm the same day
voice: A missing seal should not stop a batch. Vision Analytical holds spares and consumables for {manufacturer} systems and dispatches fast. Send your part number through {website}.

campaigns.label: Calibration
headlines: Calibration that stands up to audit
subheads: Traceable calibration with documented results for {instrument}
On-site calibration, reports the same visit
Scheduled so it never lapses
voice: Calibration is not paperwork, it is evidence. Vision Analytical calibrates {instrument} against traceable standards and issues the report on the same visit. Book a slot at {website}.

campaigns.label: Operator Training
subheads: Practical training on {instrument} for analysts and QC teams
Run it, troubleshoot it, document it
On your instrument, in your lab
voice: Most instrument problems are method problems. Vision Analytical trains your analysts on {instrument} - running it, troubleshooting it and documenting it properly. Schedule a session at {website}.

campaigns.label: Relocation & Installation
subheads: De-installation, transport and re-qualification of {instrument}
Packed properly, installed properly, verified properly
One team from unplug to first injection
voice: Moving a lab is where instruments get damaged. Vision Analytical handles {instrument} from de-installation to re-qualification, and verifies it runs before we leave. Plan your move at {website}.
